decisions.reason: Launched only in 2023, the fouling detection automation still has unresolved but promising prospects in process industries, and as a software and automation add-on to the firm's equipment it costs little to keep, so the option should stay open.
A web tool for weir dimensioning is cheap to maintain and supports the core equipment business by generating leads, so dropping it after one year would forfeit option value at negligible savings.

The fouling detection system is a young product whose market value is not yet revealed, and keeping it alongside the related automation offering preserves a low-cost growth option in condition monitoring.
